quality_INPUT.source: GWOSC preferred/default network_matched_filter_snr plus standard GR IMR remnant medians published before deformation analysis
quality_INPUT.scope: GR full-IMR, not inspiral-only or independent of strain. Default SNR may be PE or loudest search. No posterior-width or measured deformation cut.
quality_INPUT.missing: AWAITING_GR_METADATA; not failure or acceptance. Table availability is administrative pendingness, not physical selection.
quality_INPUT.uncertainty: Point-median INPUT, intervals not propagated into eligibility. Future metadata fill applies exactly the same rule before test posterior.
quality_INPUT.authority: Implementation choice within order E0.3; no human approval inferred. Draft waiting-user wording superseded here by principal agent adoption.

observables.primary: Full paired pSEOB posterior dtau220 with calibrated c(sigma)/c(SNR) and normalized selection
observables.secondary: dtau440, variants only220 and220+440; deformation440 INPUT
observables.route_IV: Population width of df220 from full posterior likelihoods, common mean free

statistics.ln_B: Relative restricted-model evidence versus GR, same normalized nuisance prior and selection; absent normalization => null, never KDE score relabeled BF

relative_exclusion_rule.scope: Operational decision rule, not universal statistical definition of exclusion

statistics.matched_z: delta.T C^-1 (y-Xm)/sqrt(delta.T C^-1 delta); E1 local covariance only synthetic INPUT until physically calibrated
statistics.multiple_readings: Report all ten; no selection. Any global claim requires Bonferroni p<=p5/number_testable_readings and separate secondary-channel accounting; per-reading5 remains labeled per-reading
statistics.jackknife: All leave-one-event-out results and verdict changes; a discovery needs every deletion same direction and no relative exclusion reversal
statistics.weight_dominance: Compute tau inverse-variance and IV inverse-fourth-weight shares; above cap blocks population discovery but does not drop event
statistics.split_null: Seeded event permutation alternating halves; compare nuisance-corrected means with covariance including shared nuisance. p<.01 blocks combination; calibration required

systematic_gate.calibration_required: two-family injected free source recovery at relevant SNR; covariance, coverage, selection and transfer, hash-linked review

nulls.E3_3_later: Two-family PE injection bias/c(SNR)/sigma_sys and brownian transfer; N/seeds/jobs in witnessed E3.2 allocation before execution
nulls.interpretation: Empirical p and confidence intervals, analytic checks; no pass/fail tuning or declaration of physical 5sigma. IV empirical UL explicit; target jitter only labels prospective N

route_IV.weights: Fisher for variance scales sigma^-4; full likelihood used, no posterior-width selection
route_IV.secondary_jumps: Center by jointly fitted nuisance mean; count posterior outlier probabilities abs(df-mu)>3*sigma_i; mixture fraction free Uniform[0,1]; empirical null and trials required, otherwise descriptive only

other_unravelings.Cauchy: variance undefined in ideal process, robust MAD required; never equate to Gaussian sd
other_unravelings.Poisson_pm_pi_over_2: zero-jump component plus outliers; separate mixture test, not Brownian width likelihood
